                                           ORDINANCE


BE IT ORDAINED B Y THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICA GO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is
hereby amended by changing all the RS-3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District
symbols and indications as shown on Map 20-H in the area bounded by


       a line 166 feet south of and parallel to West 83'"'' Street; the alley next east of and parallel
to South Paulina Street; a line 216 feet south of and parallel to West 83Street; and South
Paulina Street

to those of an RT-4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District and a
corresponding use district is hereby estabUshed in the area above described.

SECTION 2. Tliis ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.



                                  Howard Brookins Jr., Aldemian, 21'"Ward
